name: Birt-Hogg-Dubé Syndrome Pulmonary Manifestations

criteria.description: Presence of multiple bilateral pulmonary cysts on high-resolution CT scan
History of spontaneous pneumothorax, often recurrent
Family history of Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome or related manifestations
Family history of spontaneous pneumothorax without other cause
Identification of pathogenic FLCN gene mutation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multiple bilateral pulmonary cysts plus either spontaneous pneumothorax or pathogenic FLCN mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often supported by skin and renal manifestations but pulmonary features alone can establish diagnosis with genetic confirmation.

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic thin-walled cysts predominantly in lower medial and subpleural lung zones
Often occurs in early adulthood and may be the initial presenting symptom

common.notes: May result from lung cyst burden or pneumothorax episodes
Typically pleuritic and associated with pneumothorax
Benign skin tumors often present in BHD but supportive for diagnosis

occasional.notes: Rarely reported, may indicate cyst rupture or secondary infection
Often oncocytomas or chromophobe renal cell carcinoma

rare.notes: Very rare and not typical of BHD

laboratory: Genetic testing revealing pathogenic FLCN gene mutation
imaging: High-resolution CT showing multiple thin-walled bilateral pulmonary cysts, predominantly in lower medial and subpleural lung zones
other: Renal ultrasound or MRI detecting renal tumors

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly affects females of childbearing age
Cysts and nodules predominantly in upper lobes
Presence of Langerhans cells on biopsy

redFlags: Family history of pneumothorax or renal tumors
Detection of multiple bilateral pulmonary cysts on imaging
references: Schmidt LS, Linehan WM. Molecular genetics and clinical features of Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome. Nat Rev Urol. 2015;12(10):558-569.
Toro JR, et al. Lung cysts, spontaneous pneumothorax, and genetic associations in Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2007;175(10):1044-1053.
Gupta N, et al. Pulmonary manifestations of Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome. Ann Am Thorac Soc. 2017;14(8):1197-1204.
